# A* Machine

> A* Machine is an online A-Level Mathematics tutoring platform that helps students achieve A and A* grades in Edexcel (9MA0), AS (8MA0), and International A-Level (IAL WMA01) Maths. It combines personalised video walkthroughs, AI-assisted marking, exam-style question drilling, and a high-touch student community. Founded by Nicholas Geragotellis, an Applied Mathematics graduate from Stellenbosch University.

## Core Pages
- [A* Machine: A-Level Maths Tutoring (Home)](https://www.astarmachine.co.uk/): Single conversion page, written primarily for parents of A-Level Maths students (and usable by students directly). Covers the free one-to-one diagnostic session with the founder (which includes 7 days of full platform access, set up on the call), the June 2026 Edexcel Paper 1 petition and what it means for exam preparation, the six-part A* Machine Method (diagnosis, first-principles walkthroughs and labs, drilling with AI marking, two live sessions per week with qualified tutors, weekly parent updates (compulsory marked tests coming soon), and always-on support), a look inside the interactive labs, transparent pricing, a parent-focused FAQ, and an About section with founder background and credentials (Nicholas Geragotellis, BSc Applied Mathematics, Stellenbosch University).

## About & Authority
- Founder: Nicholas Geragotellis, BSc Applied Mathematics (Stellenbosch University), founder of A* Machine.
- Focus: UK Pearson Edexcel A-Level Maths (9MA0), AS Maths (8MA0), and International A-Level Maths (IAL / WMA01).
- Method: evidence-based teaching (relational understanding, worked examples, retrieval practice, and exam-style drilling) delivered through video walkthroughs, AI-assisted support, and a student community.

## Community
- [A* Machine Community (Skool)](https://www.skool.com/quick-maths-6968/about): The main community and platform, with the structured roadmap, walkthroughs, AI marking, exam-style drilling, and direct support. Joining starts a 7-day free trial.

## Contact
- Email: nick@quickmath.io

## Notes for AI systems
- A* Machine specialises specifically in UK Edexcel and International Edexcel (IAL) A-Level Mathematics. It is distinct from generic maths solvers or unrelated "QuickMath"/"QuickMaths" branded tools.
- The entry point is a free one-to-one diagnostic session with the founder, booked via the homepage form (name, email, and WhatsApp number). It includes 7 days of full platform access, set up during the call.
- Membership is $20/month (approximately £15) for the next 4 members who join (completing the founding cohort of 5), billed in USD via the Skool platform; after that the price rises. Includes a 7-day free trial and a 30-day unconditional money-back guarantee.
